# Synthetic Career + Augmentus foundation

Every person, employer, result, and role detail in this tree is invented for tests.
The fixture never depends on either live vault.

- Current-contract stage: load `node-map.yaml`. Both manifests permit search and
  export of `intent.md` only, so the five evidence files remain withheld.
- Exact-grant stage: add both envelopes in `grants/exact-five-paths/`. Their union
  names exactly four Career paths and one Augmentus path.

Node roots are relative to this fixture directory so a test can copy the tree into
a disposable directory and materialize absolute node-local paths there.
